VEILHOLLOW

A downloadable game for Windows

Download NowName your own price

The gas station is empty. His memory is emptier.

A PSX-style psychological survival horror game.
Small-town Pennsylvania, 1996.

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

You are Simon Veil — a private investigator who wakes up at an abandoned gas station on Route 12 with no memory of how he got there.

The case file is open. Catalog the scene. Follow the evidence.

The answers are closer than he thinks.

Features

  • PS1-era visuals — low-poly models, dithered post-processing
  • Investigation-driven exploration, not combat
  • No HUD. Just you, a lighter, and a case that doesn't add up
  • 15–25 minutes of gameplay in this demo build

Inspired by

Silent Hill 1–2, Resident Evil 1–3, and the things people choose not to remember.

This is our first project. Your feedback means a lot to us — thank you for checking it out.

Silver Grain Games — an indie dev team of two.



The build is made for Windows, but it also runs well on Linux through Wine/Proton.

If you're using Steam Play/Proton: right-click the executable → Properties → set compatibility to a recent Proton version.

If you're using standalone Wine: wine VEILHOLLOW.exe from the extracted folder should work out of the box.
